svg.title: Known-best packing of 90 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=90 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-15 exact rational centre and half-angle certificate at 90, in Evan Daniel's text format, read exactly from the retained source file. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=90 known best: side ~ 9.998277167 (certified upper bound)
